text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Seeei! 
...—Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Splendid, splendid! 
What a magnificent triple leap!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! After all, this routine was 
designed 
around human prayers for a flawless jump!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So Boo's gonna pull it off! I've got total 
confidence! 
That my wish and the Trainer's wish 
—can both come true at the exact same 
time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yukippe~! 
Over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, where in tarnation are ya 
runnin' off to~?! 
Camp's endin' today and all...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Which is exactly why! 
Yukippe, let's write an e-ma-ya♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An ema? 
You got a wish you wanna make, Maya-chan?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Could it be about the GⅠ races startin' 
this autumn? 
Or maybe—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I wanna pull the person I love super, 
duper close to my heart♡

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It might not be about racing, 
but it's a super precious wish to Maya. 
...A really, really important one.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...—Maya-cha...――ah.

"Whether you're running races or not, 
it's okay to have wishes you wanna grant 
together with humans."

"And rituals are what carry those wishes 
up to the heavens. 
Just like our—Oohiki Mikoshi!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Aye, you're right on that.

We've received so much help from everyone 
again this year. 
I have to repay their kindness by making 
our year-end 
progress presentation a resounding 
success.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Trainer!! 
Umm... excuse meee...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Would y'all like to come visit my hometown 
sometime?! 
There's a horsegirl I really want everyone 
to meet!!

And so, as summer drew to a close, 
we received that sudden proposal.
